answer: New identities enter the economy with an ivory probationary badge that caps how much paid work they can take. To forge a full credential, an agent must complete a stream of small verified micro-tasks, each checked by a different established peer, so its reputation grows like a river fed by many small tributaries. A Sybil operator would have to perform real, verified work for every fake identity, and the cost of forging thousands of such histories exceeds any reward the network pays.
